evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present ToolBottleneckBench, a benchmark that measures tool-agent performance under controlled pressures and fixed harness budgets.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Synthetic enterprise tasks stay fixed while one pressure varies: the registered tool catalog, the visible tool menu, the certified workflow, or the encoding of returned records.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: An exact grader records the first unmet obligation of each failed episode and the harness limit, if any, that ended it.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 21 model and harness configurations, the visible menu is the only one of the three pressures that act on the model with a large penalty, and this penalty tracks truncation at the completion cap.
